questions.question: 400 apples were bought at ₹1210 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹860. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of apples.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost price per apple = 1210 ÷ 100 = ₹12.10

Profit per apple = 860 ÷ 400 = ₹2.15

Selling price per apple = 12.10 + 2.15 = ₹14.25

Selling price per dozen = 14.25 × 12 = ₹171

**∴ The correct answer is ₹171.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total apples bought = 400

Cost Price (CP) per 100 apples = ₹1210

Total Profit = ₹860

1 Dozen = 12 apples

**Formula Used:**

Total SP = Total CP + Total Profit

SP per dozen = (Total SP ÷ Total apples) × 12

 
 Total CP = ₹4840
 
 
 Profit = ₹860
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total SP (400 apples) = ₹5700
 
 
 SP per Dozen = ₹171

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total CP of 400 apples = 1210 × (400 ÷ 100) = ₹4840

⇒ Total SP of 400 apples = 4840 + 860 = ₹5700

⇒ SP of 1 apple = 5700 ÷ 400 = ₹14.25

⇒ SP of 1 dozen (12 apples) = 14.25 × 12 = ₹171

**∴ The correct answer is ₹171.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Profit & Loss Formulas

Profit = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP) | Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Unitary Method

To find the price of multiple items, calculate the price of a single item first (Total Value ÷ Total Quantity), then multiply by the required number of items.

Common Quantities

1 Dozen = 12 items | 1 Score = 20 items | 1 Gross = 144 items (12 dozens).

questions.question: Ashish has two grandsons Ketan and Mahesh. 15 year old Ketan gets some money from Ashish’s wealth and 16 year old Mahesh gets rest of the money. But Ketan and Mahesh will get money only when they turn 23 years old. Till then the money is in a bank getting interest at rate 4% compounded annually. When both turn 23, they receive the same amount. How much had Ashish given Mahesh (in ₹) initially, if total money with Ashish was ₹25500?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When amounts are equal at CI, ratio of principal shares P₂ / P₁ = (1 + R / 100)t¹ − t²

Time for Ketan = 23 − 15 = 8 years | Time for Mahesh = 23 − 16 = 7 years

Ratio Mahesh : Ketan = (1 + 4/100)⁸ − ⁷ = 104 / 100 = 26 / 25

Total parts = 26 + 25 = 51 parts ⇒ ₹25500

Mahesh's share = 26 parts = 26 × (25500 ÷ 51) = ₹13000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13000.**

Rate of interest (R) = 4% compounded annually

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Amount, A = P(1 + R/100)t

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 25%, 35% and 40% in three successive months, but increases by 60% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price ?

Convert the successive percentage changes directly into multiplying factors:

⇒ 25% decrease = 3/4

⇒ 35% decrease = 13/20

⇒ 40% decrease = 3/5

⇒ 60% increase = 8/5

⇒ Net Multiplying Factor = (3/4) × (13/20) × (3/5) × (8/5) = 936 / 2000 = 0.468

⇒ The final price is 46.8% of original, meaning an overall decrease of 100% − 46.8% = 53.2%.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.2% decrease.**

questions.question: The average score of 5 players of a cricket team is 55. It is also observed that 3 of these 5 players have an average score of 55. What will be the average score of the remaining two players?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the overall average of a group is equal to the average of a specific subset, the average of the remaining subset must also be exactly the same.

Net deviation of the 3 players from overall average = 3 × (55 − 55) = 0.

To balance the total average, the net deviation of the remaining 2 players must also be 0.

Average of the remaining 2 players = 55 + (0 ÷ 2) = 55.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of players = 5

Overall average score of 5 players = 55

Average score of 3 of these players = 55

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values ÷ Number of values

Sum of values = Average × Number of values

 Total 5 Players: Overall Average = 55
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 3 Players
 Average = 55
 
 
 2 Players
 Average = ?
 
 Result: Required Average = 55

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total score of all 5 players = 5 × 55 = 275

⇒ Total score of the 3 players = 3 × 55 = 165

⇒ Score of the remaining 2 players = Total score of 5 players − Total score of 3 players

⇒ Score of the remaining 2 players = 275 − 165 = 110

⇒ Average score of the remaining 2 players = 110 ÷ 2 = 55

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

When two groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ have individual averages A₁ and A₂, the combined average is calculated as: A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Net Deviation Method

The sum of all deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic average is always equal to zero. Deviation is calculated as (Observation value − Average).

Weighted Average

Used when items have different frequencies or weights. Weighted Average = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ).
</p

questions.question: The greatest number, which divides 2248 and 1761 to leave 3 and 1 respectively as remainders, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The required number is the HCF of (2248 − 3) and (1761 − 1).

⇒ Required HCF = HCF of 2245 and 1760

Since the last digits of 2245 and 1760 are 5 and 0 respectively, both numbers are exactly divisible by 5.

Checking the given options, only 5 perfectly divides both 2245 and 1760.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers to be divided = 2248 and 1761

Respective remainders = 3 and 1

**Formula Used:**

Required number = HCF of (N₁ − R₁) and (N₂ − R₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ First Number = 2248 − 3 = 2245

⇒ Second Number = 1761 − 1 = 1760

⇒ Required Number = HCF of 2245 and 1760

⇒ Prime factorization of 2245 = 5 × 449

⇒ Prime factorization of 1760 = 2⁵ × 5 × 11

⇒ The highest common factor of both the numbers is 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF leaving different remainders

The greatest number that divides a, b, and c leaving remainders x, y, and z respectively is the HCF of (a − x), (b − y), and (c − z).

HCF leaving same remainder (known)

The greatest number that divides a, b, and c leaving the same remainder r in each case is the HCF of (a − r), (b − r), and (c − r).

HCF leaving same remainder (unknown)

The greatest number that divides a, b, and c leaving the same unknown remainder in each case is the HCF of |a − b|, |b − c|, and |c − a|.

LCM leaving same remainder

The smallest number that, when divided by a, b, and c, leaves the same remainder r in each case is given by [LCM of (a, b, c)] + r.
</p

questions.question: The speed of a train is 65 km per hour. In 35 minutes and 15 seconds, the train will cover _____ km and ____ metres.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Convert the time directly into hours: 35 min 15 sec = 35.25 min = 35.25 ÷ 60 hr = 47/80 hr.

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 65 × (47 ÷ 80) = 611 ÷ 16 = 38.1875 km.

Separate km and m: 38 km + (0.1875 × 1000) m = 38 km and 187.5 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 38 km and 187.5 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at speeds of 50 km/h and 80 km/h. The length of one train is 480 m. The time taken by them to cross each other is 28 seconds. The length (in m) of the other train, correct to 2 decimal places, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of trains in opposite directions = 50 + 80 = 130 km/h.

Convert speed to m/s: 130 × (5/18) = 325/9 m/s.

Total distance covered = Speed × Time = (325/9) × 28 = 9100/9 ≈ 1011.11 m.

Length of the second train = Total distance − Length of the first train.

Length of second train = 1011.11 − 480 = 531.11 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 531.11 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: Ramu invested some money in HDFC at 4% per annum rate of interest. What would be the corresponding simple interest (in ₹) if after 2 years, Ramu got ₹127.5 as compound interest, considering annual compounding?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 2 years, the direct ratio relation between Compound Interest (CI) and Simple Interest (SI) is:

⇒ CI ÷ SI = (200 + R) ÷ 200

⇒ 127.5 ÷ SI = (200 + 4) ÷ 200 = 204 ÷ 200 = 51 ÷ 50

⇒ SI = (127.5 × 50) ÷ 51 = 2.5 × 50 = ₹125

**∴ The correct answer is ₹125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

Compound Interest (CI) = ₹127.5

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 28 days; B and C can do the same work in 18 days and A, B and C together can do it in 16 days. The time required (in days) to finish the work by A and C is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(28, 18, 16) = 1008 units

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 1008 ÷ 16 = 63 units/day

Efficiency of A = 63 − (1008 ÷ 18) = 63 − 56 = 7 units/day

Efficiency of C = 63 − (1008 ÷ 28) = 63 − 36 = 27 units/day

Time taken by (A + C) = 1008 ÷ (7 + 27) = 1008 ÷ 34 = 504 ÷ 17 = 29¹¹/₁₇ days

**∴ The correct answer is 29¹¹/₁₇ days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A and B = 28 days

Time taken by B and C = 18 days

Time taken by A, B and C together = 16 days

⇒ Efficiency of A = Efficiency of (A + B + C) − Efficiency of (B + C)

⇒ Efficiency of A = 63 − 56 = 7 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = Efficiency of (A + B + C) − Efficiency of (A + B)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 63 − 36 = 27 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and C = 7 + 27 = 34 units/day

⇒ Time required by A and C = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time required = 1008 ÷ 34 = 504 ÷ 17 days

⇒ Time required = 29¹¹/₁₇ days

**∴ The correct answer is 29¹¹/₁₇ days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is considered as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the given individual times taken by each person or group.

Efficiency Formula

Efficiency is defined as the total work done per unit time. Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken.

Combined Work

When multiple people work together, their combined total efficiency is always the sum of their individual efficiencies.
</p

questions.question: The third proportional of numbers a and b is ab. Which of the following statements is true?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For terms in continued proportion, the product of extremes equals the product of means.

Given the third proportional condition: a : b :: b : ab

We can directly write: a × ab = b × b

a²b = b²

Dividing by b on both sides, we get a² = b.

**∴ The correct answer is a² = b.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number = a

Second number = b

Third proportional = ab

**Formula Used:**

If c is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b = b : c, which implies c = b² / a.

 Third Proportional Condition: a : b = b : c

**Calculation:**

⇒ a / b = b / ab

Cross-multiplying the proportional terms:

⇒ a × ab = b × b

⇒ a²b = b²

Assuming b ≠ 0 (since proportional base values are non-zero), divide both sides by b:

⇒ a² = b

**∴ The correct answer is a² = b.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

For two numbers a and b, the third proportional c is calculated using the standard continued proportion a : b = b : c, which yields the formula c = b² / a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional (or geometric mean) between two positive numbers a and b is represented by the formula √(ab).

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d is found using the direct proportion a : b = c : d, which implies d = (bc) / a.
</p

questions.question: When 12, 15, 18, 20 and 25 divide the least number x, the remainder in each case was 3 but x was divisible by 7. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the number x is perfectly divisible by 7, we can directly check the given options for divisibility by 7.

390 ÷ 7 → Remainder 5

930 ÷ 7 → Remainder 6

903 ÷ 7 → Remainder 0 (Exactly divisible)

309 ÷ 7 → Remainder 1

**∴ The correct answer is 903.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Divisors = 12, 15, 18, 20 and 25

Remainder in each case = 3

The number is exactly divisible by 7.

**Concept Used:**

The least number which when divided by given numbers leaves a common remainder r is of the form: (LCM of numbers) × k + r, where k is a positive integer (1, 2, 3, ...).

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, find the LCM of 12, 15, 18, 20, 25 using prime factorization:

⇒ 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ 20 = 2² × 5

⇒ 25 = 5²

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3² × 5² = 4 × 9 × 25 = 900

⇒ The required number x must be of the form: 900k + 3

⇒ Given that x is divisible by 7, so (900k + 3) must be a multiple of 7.

⇒ We can rewrite 900k + 3 as: (128 × 7 + 4)k + 3

⇒ 900k + 3 = 128 × 7k + (4k + 3)

⇒ Since 128 × 7k is completely divisible by 7, the remainder term (4k + 3) must also be divisible by 7.

⇒ Let's check values for k:

⇒ If k = 1: 4(1) + 3 = 7 (Which is perfectly divisible by 7)

⇒ So, the least value of x is obtained when k = 1.

⇒ x = 900(1) + 3 = 903

**∴ The correct answer is 903.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Same Remainder Concept

The least number which leaves the same remainder 'r' when divided by a, b, and c is given by the formula: LCM(a, b, c) + r.

Different Remainder Concept

If the respective differences between divisors and remainders are the same (i.e., a−x = b−y = c−z = k), the required number is: LCM(a, b, c) − k.

Divisibility Rule of 7

Double the last digit of the number and subtract it from the remaining part. If the result is 0 or a multiple of 7, the original number is divisible by 7.
</p

questions.question: Which of the following schemes provide the highest discount?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The equivalent discount of two successive discounts x% and y% is approximately equal to their sum (x + y)% for comparison purposes.

Scheme 1: 10 + 3 = 13% | Scheme 2: 10 + 10 = 20%

Scheme 3: 7 + 10 = 17% | Scheme 4: 5 + 10 = 15%

Scheme 2 has the highest sum, thereby yielding the highest equivalent discount of 19%.

**∴ The correct answer is Two successive discounts of 10% each (19%).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Scheme 1: 10% and 3%

Scheme 2: 10% and 10%

Scheme 3: 7% and 10%

Scheme 4: 5% and 10%

**Formula Used:**

Equivalent discount for two successive discounts x% and y% = (x + y − x × y / 100)%

 Effective Discount % Comparison
 10% and 3%
 
 12.7%
 10% and 10%
 
 19.0% (Highest)
 7% and 10%
 
 16.3%
 5% and 10%
 
 14.5%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Discount for Scheme 1 = 10 + 3 − (10 × 3) / 100 = 13 − 0.3 = 12.7%

⇒ Discount for Scheme 2 = 10 + 10 − (10 × 10) / 100 = 20 − 1 = 19%

⇒ Discount for Scheme 3 = 7 + 10 − (7 × 10) / 100 = 17 − 0.7 = 16.3%

⇒ Discount for Scheme 4 = 5 + 10 − (5 × 10) / 100 = 15 − 0.5 = 14.5%

⇒ Scheme 2 provides the highest overall discount at 19%.

**∴ The correct answer is Two successive discounts of 10% each (19%).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts Formula

When two discounts of x% and y% are given consecutively, the overall effective discount is calculated using the formula (x + y − x × y / 100)%.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

The final Selling Price (SP) after successive discounts d₁% and d₂% is determined as SP = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100).

Buy X Get Y Free

For promotional offers formatted as 'Buy X Get Y Free', the equivalent discount percentage is given by (Y ÷ (X + Y)) × 100%.
</p

questions.question: Rajesh bought 5 kg of apples for Rs. 875 and sold it for Rs. 220 per kg. How much is the profit gained by him?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Selling Price (SP) of 5 kg apples = 220 × 5 = Rs. 1100

Total Cost Price (CP) of 5 kg apples = Rs. 875

Profit = Total SP − Total CP = 1100 − 875 = Rs. 225

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 225.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of 5 kg apples = Rs. 875

Selling Price (SP) of 1 kg apples = Rs. 220

**Formula Used:**

Total SP = SP per kg × Total Quantity

Profit = Total SP − Total CP

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Total CP = Rs. 875
 
 
 Total SP = Rs. 1100
 
 

 Profit = Rs. 225

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total SP of 5 kg apples = 220 × 5 = Rs. 1100

⇒ Profit = Total SP − Total CP

⇒ Profit = 1100 − 875

⇒ Profit = Rs. 225

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 225.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Percentage

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Loss Percentage

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100

Marked Price & Discount

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) − Discount
</p

questions.question: The fourth proportional of a, c and bc is d. The fourth proportional of (bc²)/(a), (ad)/(c) and c is _____.

From the first proportion (a, c, bc, d): a × d = c × bc ⇒ ad = bc²

⇒ According to the rule of proportion for the first set: a × d = c × bc

⇒ ad = bc² ... (Equation 1)

⇒ According to the rule of proportion for the second set: (bc²/a) × x = (ad/c) × c

⇒ (bc²/a) × x = ad

⇒ Substitute ad = bc² from Equation 1 into the above expression:

⇒ (bc²/a) × x = bc²

⇒ x / a = 1

⇒ x = a

**∴ The correct answer is a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a : b :: c : d), then d is the fourth proportional. It is calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportional. It is calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the square root of their product. It is calculated as √(a × b).
</p

questions.question: The ratio of the areas of two triangles is 4 : 3 and the ratio of their heights is 3 : 4. The ratio of their bases is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

We know that Area ∝ Base × Height.

Therefore, Base Ratio = Area Ratio ÷ Height Ratio.

⇒ Base Ratio = (4 / 3) ÷ (3 / 4)

⇒ Base Ratio = (4 / 3) × (4 / 3) = 16 / 9

**∴ The correct answer is 16 : 9.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of areas (A₁ : A₂) = 4 : 3

Ratio of heights (h₁ : h₂) = 3 : 4

**Formula Used:**

Area of a triangle = ½ × Base × Height

 Ratio of Triangle Bases
 
 

 
• 
 

 h₁ = 3
 A₁ = 4
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Base 1 = b₁

 

 
• 
 

 h₂ = 4
 A₂ = 3
 
•

• 
 Base 2 = b₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ A₁ / A₂ = (½ × b₁ × h₁) / (½ × b₂ × h₂)

⇒ A₁ / A₂ = (b₁ / b₂) × (h₁ / h₂)

Substitute the given ratios:

⇒ 4 / 3 = (b₁ / b₂) × (3 / 4)

⇒ b₁ / b₂ = (4 / 3) × (4 / 3)

⇒ b₁ / b₂ = 16 / 9

**∴ The correct answer is 16 : 9.**

**__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

When all sides are equal, Area = (√3 / 4) × a², where a is the side length.

Heron's Formula

When all three sides (a, b, c) are known, Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)], where s is the semi-perimeter (a+b+c)/2.

Similar Triangles Property

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of the squares of their corresponding heights or bases.
</p

questions.question: The average weight of Gopal, Akshay and Atul is 45 kg. If the average weight of Gopal and Akshay be 43 kg and that of Akshay and Atul be 43 kg, then the weight of Akshay (in kg) is:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total weight of all 3 persons = 45 × 3 = 135 kg.

Total weight of (Gopal + Akshay) = 43 × 2 = 86 kg.

Total weight of (Akshay + Atul) = 43 × 2 = 86 kg.

Since Akshay is counted twice in the two pairs, his weight = Sum of pairs − Total weight.

Weight of Akshay = (86 + 86) − 135 = 172 − 135 = 37 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 37 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of Gopal, Akshay, and Atul = 45 kg

Average weight of Akshay and Atul = 43 kg

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

Extra Interest = (Extra Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

600 = [(9400 − 5400) × R × 4] ÷ 100

questions.question: There are 1224 employees in an organisation, out of which 25% are promoted. How many such employees are there who got promotion?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

25% directly corresponds to the fraction 1/4 of the total base value.

Number of promoted employees = Total employees ÷ 4

⇒ 1224 ÷ 4 = 306

**∴ The correct answer is 306.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 Total Employees = 1224 (100%)
 
 
 
 Promoted
 
 
 
 Not Promoted (75%)
 
 
 0%
 
• 
 25% = ?
 100%

 
 25% of 1224 = 306

**Given:**

Total number of employees = 1224

Percentage of employees who got promoted = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Promoted employees = (Percentage Promoted ÷ 100) × Total Employees

**Calculation:**

⇒ Promoted employees = (25 ÷ 100) × 1224

⇒ Promoted employees = (1 ÷ 4) × 1224

⇒ Promoted employees = 306

**∴ The correct answer is 306.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Equivalent of Percentages

To calculate standard percentages quickly, always convert them into simplified fractions (e.g., 25% = 1/4, 50% = 1/2, 75% = 3/4).

Base of Percentage

Percentages are always calculated with respect to a base value. In this scenario, the base value (100%) represents the total workforce strength, which is 1224 employees.

Direct Division Technique

You can quickly find 25% of any even number by simply halving the total value twice. For example: 1224 ÷ 2 = 612, and 612 ÷ 2 = 306.
</p
